answer: An agent marketplace enforces sybil resistance by requiring each identity to lock a onyx-bonded stake of 180 POA for 21 days. A verifier checks the tide ledger each epoch: any duplicate identity caught sharing hardware or IP forfeits the full bond. An attacker spinning 500 fakes must lock 500 × 180 = 90,000 POA, all frozen while honest agents earn fees. The atlas record seals each bond issuance, making the cost of a sybil swarm explicit and prohibitive.
